WITH v AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, member_key, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS n_versions
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT home_store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_first, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS n_distinct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n_versions>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_version
FROM v
WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(home_store_id)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AS any_version_join,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AS rows_any,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND home_store_id=999) AS store999,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT join_date)>1)) AS members_varying_join,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, valid_from FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_versions,
 (SELECT MAX(join_date) FROM dim_member) AS max_join,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-24') AS prev_day,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-26') AS next_day,
 (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member m LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=m.home_store_id AND s.is_current WHERE m.join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND s.store_id IS NULL AND m.home_store_id<>900) AS unknown_store
